import os
import pytest
import ops
from ops.model import _ModelBackend

def fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, name, script):
    path = bin_dir / name
    path.write_text('#!/bin/sh\n' + script + '\n')
    path.chmod(0o755)

def test_permission_denied_maps_to_relation_not_found(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    bin_dir = tmp_path / 'bin'
    bin_dir.mkdir()
    monkeypatch.setenv('PATH', str(bin_dir) + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
    monkeypatch.setenv('JUJU_VERSION', '3.6.0')
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'relation-ids', 'echo \'db:2\'')
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'relation-list', 'echo \'provider\'')
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'relation-get', 'echo \'ERROR permission denied\' >&2; exit 1')
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'is-leader', 'echo \'true\'')
    model = ops.Model(ops.CharmMeta.from_yaml('name: my-charm\nrequires: {db: {interface: db}}'), _ModelBackend('my-charm/0'))
    try:
        relation = model.get_relation('db', 2)
        data = relation.data[model.app]
    except ops.RelationNotFoundError:
        data = {}
    assert data == {}

import os
import pytest
import ops
from ops.model import _ModelBackend


def fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, name, script):
    path = bin_dir / name
    path.write_text('#!/bin/sh\n' + script + '\n')
    path.chmod(0o755)


def test_permission_denied_is_mapped_to_relationnotfounderror(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    bin_dir = tmp_path / 'bin'
    bin_dir.mkdir()
    monkeypatch.setenv('PATH', str(bin_dir) + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
    monkeypatch.setenv('JUJU_VERSION', '3.6.0')

    # Fake the hook tools
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'relation-get', "echo 'ERROR permission denied' >&2; exit 1")
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'relation-ids', "echo '[\"db:2\"]'")
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'relation-list', "echo '[]'")
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'is-leader', "echo true")

    meta = '''name: my-charm
requires:
  db:
    interface: db
'''

    model = ops.Model(ops.CharmMeta.from_yaml(meta), _ModelBackend('my-charm/0'))

    try:
        # Trigger the bug: try to read from a gone relation
        relation = model.get_relation('db', 2)
        relation.data[relation.app]
    except ops.RelationNotFoundError:
        # Expected behavior
        pass
    except ops.ModelError as e:
        pytest.fail(f'Should have mapped permission denied to RelationNotFoundError, but got: {e}')

def test_relation_get_permission_denied_mapped_to_relation_not_found(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    bin_dir = tmp_path / 'bin'

    monkeypatch.setenv('PATH', str(bin_dir) + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
    monkeypatch.setenv('JUJU_VERSION', '3.6.0')

    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'is-leader', 'echo true')
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'relation-get', 'echo ERROR permission denied >&2; exit 1')
    model = ops.Model(ops.CharmMeta.from_yaml('name: myapp\nrequires: {db: {interface: db}}\n'), _ModelBackend('myapp/0'))
    # Catch the error the bug raises, so the bug fails the assert below.
    try:

import os
import json

import ops
from ops.model import _ModelBackend
import pytest


def fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, name, script):
    path = bin_dir / name
    path.write_text('#!/bin/sh\n' + script + '\n')
    path.chmod(0o755)


def test_permission_denied_mapped_to_relation_not_found(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    bin_dir = tmp_path / 'bin'
    bin_dir.mkdir()
    monkeypatch.setenv('PATH', str(bin_dir) + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
    monkeypatch.setenv('JUJU_VERSION', '3.6.0')

    # Fake all the hook tools the code path calls.
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'relation-ids', 'echo \'["db:1"]\'')
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'relation-list', 'echo \'["provider/0"]\'')
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'is-leader', 'echo true')
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'relation-get', 'echo >&2 "ERROR permission denied"; exit 1')

    meta = '''
    name: my-app
    requires:
      db:
        interface: db
    '''
    model = ops.Model(ops.CharmMeta.from_yaml(meta), _ModelBackend('my-app/0'))

    with pytest.raises(ops.RelationNotFoundError):
        model.get_relation('db', 1)
